_what_this_is: The invariant core of MSSP's own FMS. Every branch carries these keys VERBATIM. A branch that changes one fails the build and is named. This is the teeth behind 差異性可以有，但不能全部都改 — differences are allowed, changing everything is not.
_who_may_change_it: All three branches must change it together, and then Neo decides. That is a 大版本改動 under 模組 06 and this file is not a route around it.
_why_duplicated_rather_than_referenced: A branch that merely referenced the core could not disagree with it, so nothing would be checkable. The same principle as example 011's units map: a claim is verifiable only when the fact exists in two places and they can be compared.

sets.FMS: 第一主母集 — structure, contract and declaration
sets.SCL: 系統控制層 — what this deployment treats as fatal
sets.SMS: 第二主母集 — the capabilities without which the system is not itself
sets.TMS: 第三主母集 — one unit per capability, each an island
sets.DMS: 展示母集 — what a person can see of what actually happened

identity_test: Remove it and ask whether the system is still itself. If yes it is TMS; if no it is SMS.
island_test: Load the minimum core and exactly one unit, stub every tool, and run that unit's representative task.
sibling_rule: No TMS unit reaches a sibling TMS unit.
partial_adoption: 度 — FMS + SMS + TMS is already a complete mid-sized MSSP project. A set earns its place by making something possible that was not.
